title: opcua plugin: convert to ws_log system
description:
Use the `ws_log` system instead of a special `#define` for the opcua
plugin. If Wireshark isn't compiled for a Debug target, the compiler
will optimize away all these calls.

Ping #19519

notes.body:
added 3 commits
  • ec3beb8b...2236a864 - 2 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 2fe6220b - opcua plugin: convert to ws_log system
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/20324/diffs?diff_id=1400631924&start_sha=ec3beb8b5a2113ffdb4e9043e419be01f042badb)

I both love this and am unsure about it.  I've noticed this "phenomenon" in several dissectors and wiretaps - a "personalized" debug macro.  I like the idea of standardization like I think this patch is trying to do, but also understand the "flexibility" with individual macros and only turning it "on" for a single piece of functionality.  In "practice" will it not matter because this would only show up for opcua (or pick your favorite dissector/protocol/wiretap) and won't likely overlap with other functionality someone is trying to debug?

I'm not sure what you're asking. I suggest asking it in #19519, because the topic is bigger than this MR.

In brief, though, you can tell the standardized Wireshark log system to show debug messages from [specific domains](https://www.wireshark.org/docs/wsdg_html/#ChSrcConfigureLogging) without having to recompile anything, and without having to see debug messages from domains you don't care about.
Yea, I saw this before the issue and I'm glad the discussion is happening, seems developers want to move in this direction, so no objection from me!
